lens: Critical path, milestone health, resourcing reality, revenue-at-risk.
rules_summary: Effective RAG floors at amber for unresourced work, however good the reported status.
Criticality (on the critical path) and health (RAG) are tracked separately.
Critical Revenue at Risk = revenue-tagged milestones with effective RAG amber/red that are also on the critical path.
Yes if the change reduces Critical Revenue at Risk; Conditional if it helps schedule but doesn't yet (unresourced or off-path); No otherwise.
